name: OneKDP
tagline: AI book and KDP cover generator with free manual tools
description: OneKDP is a publishing workspace for creating editable book interiors and full print-wrap covers for Amazon KDP. Generate a cover, an interior, or both, revise the layout and typography, preview them together and export print-ready files for upload through your own KDP account. It supports projects such as novels, workbooks, coloring books, journals and planners. KDP calculators and manual editing are free; AI generation uses credits, with the cost shown before creation.
